_comment: DH-G0 live-FLOW probe (D81). Exercises the capgen v2 machinery headless with NO game (probe conf = empty autoexec): boot trap (BPLM on the BDA tick cell 0x46C, armed at the parked -break-start halt), flat_guard OFF (a real-mode probe stop can never show a base-0 4GB CS; the guard itself is live-session-only), arm phase (BPDEL * + BPINT 8 as the frame-hit surrogate), runtime cell resolution (u16 COM1 base @0040:0000 = 0x3F8) feeding both an addr expression and a len expression, and the anchor-vs-per-frame watch split. These ids are deliberately NOT registry ids — a probe transcript is never stitched; it exists to prove the live capture loop mechanics.
